author: nickyeow

english.text: The matter will be brought up at the next meeting.

jyutping: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 dang2 haa6 ci3 hoi1 wui2 sin1 king1。
text: 呢個問題等下次開會先傾。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Get me up at eight.

jyutping: m4 goi1 nei5 baat3 dim2 giu3 ngo5 hei2 san1 aa1。
text: 唔該你八點叫我起身吖。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I like to eat watermelon.

jyutping: ngo5 hou3 zung1 ji3 sik6 sai1 gwaa1。
text: 我好鍾意食西瓜。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Nothing is so tasty as the dish you make.

jyutping: mou4 me1 je5 hou2 mei6 dak1 gwo3 nei5 zing2 di1 je5 sik6。
text: 無咩嘢好味得過你整啲嘢食。

author: nickyeow

english.text: What if he should happen to be late?

jyutping: maan6 jat1 keoi5 ci4 dou3 gam2 dim2 syun3 aa3？
text: 萬一佢遲到噉點算呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I am not so tall as my brother, but taller than my father.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 gau3 ngo5 sai3 lou2 gou1，daan6 hai6 ngo5 gou1 gwo3 ngo5 aa3 baa4。
text: 我唔夠我細佬高，但係我高過我阿爸。

author: nickyeow

english.text: There is a television in this room.

jyutping: ni1 gaan1 fong4 leoi5 min6 jau5 bou6 din6 si6 gei1。
text: 呢間房裏面有部電視機。

author: cantonesespoken

english.text: I will give you a laptop.
I'll give you a laptop.

jyutping: ngo5 wui5 bei2 jat1 bou6 sau2 tai4 din6 nou5 nei5。
text: 我會畀一部手提電腦你。

author: fercheung

english.text: I feed my dog once a day.

jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 wai3 zek3 gau2 jat1 ci3。
text: 我每日餵隻狗一次。

author: fercheung

english.text: I thought you'd be pleased.

jyutping: ngo5 zung6 ji5 wai4 nei5 wui5 gou1 hing3 tim1。
text: 我仲以爲你會高興添。

author: sarefo

english.text: Bill posting prohibited. Offenders will be prosecuted.

jyutping: gam3 tip3 gaai1 ziu1 wai4 ze2 gau3 zi6
text: 禁貼街招 違者究治

author: kaenif

english.text: Tell me you didn't see that coming.

jyutping: tung4 ngo5 gong2 nei5 mou5 jyu6 gai3 dou3 ngaam1 ngaam1 gin6 si6。
text: 同我講你冇預計到啱啱件事。

author: kaenif

english.text: You guys are untrustworthy.

jyutping: nei5 dei6 dou1 m4 ho2 kaau3 ge3。
text: 你哋都唔可靠嘅。

author: nickyeow

english.text: There was a small table in her bedroom, and on the table - a little bottle.

jyutping: keoi5 gaan1 seoi6 fong2 jap6 min6 jau5 zoeng1 sai3 sai3 zoeng1 ge3 toi2，toi2 soeng6 min6 jau5 go3 sai3 sai3 go3 ge3 zeon1。
text: 佢間睡房入面有張細細張嘅枱，枱上面有個細細個嘅樽。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He fell and hit his head on a rock.

jyutping: keoi5 dit3 zo2 lok6 dei6，zong6 zo2 go3 tau4 lok6 gau6 sek6 dou3。
text: 佢跌咗落地，撞咗個頭落舊石到。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Some teachers peel potatoes while teaching.

jyutping: jau5 di1 lou5 si1 wui2 jat1 lou6 gaau3 syu1 jat1 lou6 pai1 syu4 zai2 pei4。
text: 有啲老師會一路教書一路批薯仔皮。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The dragon can't be killed with ordinary weapons.

jyutping: pou2 tung1 ge3 mou5 hei3 saat3 m4 dou3 tiu4 lung4。
text: 普通嘅武器殺唔到條龍。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I can speak Chinese, but not write it.

jyutping: zung1 man4 ngo5 sik1 gong2 m4 sik1 se2。
text: 中文我識講唔識寫。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Do you guys think she'd go out with me?

jyutping: nei5 dei6 gu2 keoi5 wui5 m4 wui5 tung4 ngo5 ceot1 gaai1 aa1 naa4？
text: 你哋估佢會唔會同我出街吖嗱？

author: nickyeow

english.text: At nightfall, you can expect to see birds on the lake.

jyutping: jap6 je6 go2 zan6，wu4 min6 ho2 ji5 gin3 dou2 hou2 do1 zoek3 zai2。
text: 入夜嗰陣，湖面可以見到好多雀仔。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I find your reaction to be totally understandable.

jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 nei5 jau5 gam3 ge3 faan2 jing3 hai6 jyun4 cyun4 hap6 lei5 ge3。
text: 我覺得你有咁嘅反應係完全合理嘅。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: I actually don't know anything about it.
Actually, I don't know anything about this.

jyutping: kei4 sat6 ne1 joeng6 je5 ngo5 mat1 je5 dou1 m4 zi1 gaa3。
text: 其實呢樣嘢我乜嘢都唔知㗎。
